SigGtsrbTargetClass.meaning: the target class of the GTSRB SIG runs with the target tag

SigGtsrbRuns.meaning: GTSRB SIG runs at the tagged target class

SigGtsrbRates.meaning: rates among the GTSRB SIG runs at the tagged target class

SigGtsrbSeeds.meaning: seeds among the GTSRB SIG runs at the tagged target class

LcEpsilonBudgets.meaning: epsilon budgets in the Label-Consistent pilot

LcGtsrbPilotDiverged.meaning: Label-Consistent pilot runs on GTSRB that diverged

NewDatasetSeeds.meaning: seeds per SVHN and EuroSAT cell

GtsrbDivergedRuns.meaning: ViT GTSRB training runs whose clean accuracy collapsed below half the benign reference

GtsrbRunsScored.meaning: ViT GTSRB training runs with a recorded clean accuracy

SigGtsrbTlOneFivePercentMeanAsr.meaning: mean ASR of usable SIG GTSRB runs at target class 1 and the middle panel rate

SigGtsrbTlOneFivePercentSeedsClearing.meaning: usable SIG GTSRB seeds at target class 1 and the middle rate that clear both bars

SigGtsrbTlOneFivePercentSeeds.meaning: usable SIG GTSRB seeds at target class 1 and the middle rate

LcEpsilonChosen.value: CIFAR-10 none, CIFAR-100 none, GTSRB 16, Tiny ImageNet none
LcEpsilonChosen.meaning: the Label-Consistent epsilon over 255 the pilot rule picks per dataset, none where no run passes

LcDatasetsWithEpsilon.meaning: datasets where some Label-Consistent epsilon passes both bars

NewDatasetCellsClearingOnMean.meaning: SVHN and EuroSAT cells whose seed-mean ASR clears the bar

MultitargetRunsClearing.meaning: multi-target SIG runs whose set-wide attack success clears the bar
